newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Plains cattle quiet, few trades at $69.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Plains cattle quiet, few trades at $69.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle markets were quiet throughout the day Thursday with a small amount of cattle traded at $69.00 per cwt, down $1.00 from Wednesday's top prices, feedlot sources said.

Most feedlots passed the $69.00 bids, preferring to carry the cattle over to next week's showlists. Feedlots have been marketing cattle ahead of schedule for several weeks and managers said many of this week's offerings were light weight and could use more days on feed.
